name: Neurodivergent Reader by LoveSpark
summary: Reading focus tools: dyslexia fonts, reading ruler, paragraph focus & distraction removal. Built for ADHD & dyslexia.
description:
Neurodivergent Reader transforms any webpage into a calmer, more focused reading experience. Designed specifically for ADHD, dyslexia, and autism.

Features:
- Reading Font — Switch to OpenDyslexic, Lexend, or Atkinson Hyperlegible with adjustable size, line height, letter spacing, and word spacing
- Reading Ruler — Transparent ruler follows your cursor. Adjustable height, opacity, and color. Keyboard and touch support
- Paragraph Focus — Dims everything except the paragraph you're reading. Click to lock, j/k to navigate between paragraphs
- Distraction Removal — Hide sidebars, ads, cookie banners, and floating overlays independently. CSS-only, instantly reversible
- Per-site disable — Turn off the reader on specific domains
- Keyboard shortcuts — Shift+Arrow for ruler, j/k for paragraph navigation, Escape to unlock
- 4 cozy themes (Retro Pink, Dark, Beige, Slate)
- Full keyboard navigation and screen reader support

Privacy first: No data collection, no tracking, no ads. 100% local storage. Always free, always open source.

Part of the LoveSpark suite — retro pink productivity tools for neurodivergent coders.
